### 弗洛城

這是一張可供您用於個人專案的小鎮地圖。本地圖將會持續更新。版本：1.18.2。使用的光影包：Complementary Shaders :)

A small town map that you can use for your own projects. This map will continue to be updated. Version: 1.18.2. Shaders used: Complementary Shaders :) (ChatGPT Translate)

 

這個專案相當實用，它能讓您快速展開各類創作，例如影片拍攝、冒險地圖等用途。隨著地圖持續更新，您將能獲得愈來愈完善的使用體驗。

This project can be useful as it provides an opportunity to quickly start your own project, such as for a video, an adventure map, or other purposes. Since this map will be updated, you will gradually get an even better experience using it. (ChatGPT Translate)
